"rationale": "PNP 1:8 pair, NMOS pair equalizes emitters, giving PTAT I=UT·ln8/R1. With PMOS |Vth|≈1 V, a classic diode leaves M2 ≈0 V of Vds. An NMOS follower therefore drives pb, so the M2 drain sits ≈1.45 V. Output Vref = Veb3 + I·R2 ≈ 1.2 V. A cascode on the output plus L=2 PMOS keeps line regulation ≈5 mV/V. Current is ≈5+5+5+4+0.5 µA ≈ 20 µA, about 36 µW. The startup circuit pulls pb low while vref is low."}

PARAMS = {
    "I0":     (5e-6, 2e-6, 12e-6),    # PTAT branch current
    "r21":    (9.4, 7.5, 11.5),       # R2/R1 (sets TC / vref)
    "gmid_p": (10, 7, 14),            # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Lp":     (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # PMOS mirror L (line regulation)
    "gmid_n": (15, 10, 20),           # NMOS level-shift pair gm/Id
    "Ln":     (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),
    "Ifol":   (4e-6, 2e-6, 10e-6),    # follower bias current
    "Vcas":   (0.25, 0.15, 0.35),     # pb - pc  (Vsd of output mirror device)
    "Cc":     (5e-12, 1e-12, 15e-12), # dominant-pole cap on node d
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    m3 = 2
    VDD = 1.8
    I0 = p["I0"]
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I0
    R2 = p["r21"] * R1

    # PMOS mirror devices (identical size, ratio 1)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I0, vds=0.4)
    pb = VDD - mp.vgs
    # Output cascode PMOS (bulk tied to own source -> no body effect)
    mpc = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I0, vds=0.35)

    # NMOS pair: sources at Veb (~0.72 V), bulk vss
    veb = 0.76 + UT * math.log(I0 / 10e-6)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I0, vds=0.6, vsb=veb)

    # Source follower (level shift d -> pb)
    mf = lut.size("n", 15, 1.0, p["Ifol"], vds=VDD - pb, vsb=pb)
    Rtot = pb / p["Ifol"]
    Ra = p["Vcas"] / p["Ifol"]
    Rb = max(Rtot - Ra, 1e3)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PNP core
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "q2", m=N)
    n.R("R1", "e2", "q2", R1)
    # NMOS level-shift pair
    n.dev("M1", "g1", "g1", "e1", "vss", mn)   # diode
    n.dev("M2", "d", "g1", "e2", "vss", mn)
    # PMOS mirror
    n.dev("M4", "g1", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M3", "d", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # follower level shift: pb = d - Vgs(Mf)
    n.dev("MF", "vdd", "d", "pb", "vss", mf)
    n.R("RA", "pb", "pc", Ra)
    n.R("RB", "pc", "vss", Rb)
    n.C("CC", "d", "vdd", p["Cc"])
    # output branch (cascoded)
    n.dev("M5", "x", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M5C", "vref", "pc", "x", "x", mpc)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=m3)
    # start-up: vref low -> s high -> pull pb low
    n.M("MSP", "s", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSK", "s", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MST", "pb", "s", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 0.5)

    # predictions
    veb3 = 0.76 + UT * math.log(I0 / 10e-6) - UT * math.log(m3)
    vref = veb3 + R2 * I0
    VA = mp.intrinsic_gain / mp.gm_id           # Early voltage of PMOS
    line_reg = (R2 * I0) * (1.0 / VA) / math.log(N) + 0.1e-3
    i_tot = 3 * I0 + p["Ifol"] + 0.5e-6
    power = VDD * i_tot
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": 15.0, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "power": power, "startup_ok": 1}
